FULL TEXT:
PRESS NEWS
Applications Invited for the Post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on contractual basis under
Comprehensive Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Scheme
Applications are invited from eligible and motivated Indian candidates for filling the post of
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) purely on a contractual and temporary basis under the Comprehensive
Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Scheme in Hassanur Forest Division, Sathyamangalam Tiger
Reserve.
Eligibility Criteria & Age Limit: The applicant should preferably be a resident of Tamil Nadu and
should not be above 35 years of age as on 01.11.2026 (relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women
candidates as per Tamil Nadu Government norms). Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree with
a minimum of 55% marks in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Biology, Forestry, Ecology, Environmental
Science, Zoology, Life Sciences, or Allied Disciplines from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum
1 Year Experience in ArcGIS Software or Related GIS Applications.
Remuneration & Roles: The selected candidate will be appointed on a contractual basis for an initial
tenure of one year (extendable based on project requirements and satisfactory performance) with a
consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 25,000/- (Including HRA and Travel). The JRF will be
responsible for field monitoring of wildlife movements, conflict vulnerability hotspot mapping,
assessing linear infrastructure and elephant-proof barriers (solar fences, trenches, railway barricades),
gathering camera-trap and spatial data, and coordinating with Anti-Depredation Squads and local
community stakeholders across Hassanur, Thalavadi, Germalam, and Jeeragahalli ranges and any other
tasks.
Desirable Qualifications: Prior hands-on field experience in tracking large mammals, camera-trap
deployment, spatial analysis using GIS software (QGIS/ArcGIS), statistical modeling, and report
drafting. Basic Typing Skills in both Tamil and English. Proficiency in Tamil and English (written and
spoken) is essential to liaise effectively with frontline staff and village communities. Possession of a
valid two-wheeler driving license is advantageous.
Application Procedure: Interested candidates can download the prescribed application format from the
official Erode District website: https://erode.nic.in. The duly completed application form, accompanied
by a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), self-attested copies of academic mark sheets/certificates, proof of
age, photo identification (e.g., valid government ID card), and relevant publications/experience
certificates, must be submitted in PDF format via email to: dfohsn@gmail.com with the subject line
'Application for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) – Comprehensive Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation
Scheme. Alternatively, hard-copy applications may be submitted by post or in person to: Deputy Director
& District Forest Officer, Hassanur Forest Division, Hassanur – 638 401, Erode District, Tamil Nadu.
The last date for receipt of applications is 01.12.2026 (Tuesday) by 05:45 PM. Shortlisted
candidates will be invited for an in-person interview and technical assessment at the Hassanur Division
Office. Selection will be strictly based on merit, academic records, field aptitude, and guidelines issued
by the Tamil Nadu Forest Department.
